title: The Slower Ball — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
You grip it differently
You release it the same way
Everything about the body says express
And then the ball arrives at a different speed to the one he expected

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
La palla più lenta è una conversazione sul tempo [The slower ball is a conversation about time]
Su quanto veloce pensi di essere [About how fast you think you are]
E quanto veloce sei davvero [And how fast you actually are]
Queste sono spesso due cose diverse [Those are frequently two different things]

[Chorus — English]
The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting
The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it
The slower ball says — you've made up your mind already
The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Die langsamere Ball sagt — ich weiß was du erwartest [The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting]
Die langsamere Ball sagt — und ich werde es nicht tun [The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it]
Die langsamere Ball sagt — du hast dich schon entschieden [The slower ball says — you've already decided]
Die langsamere Ball sagt — das ist das Problem, nicht wahr? [The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Most batsmen know the slower ball is coming
That's not the point
The point is knowing it's coming and still not being ready

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The slower ball
La palla più lenta [The slower ball]
Der langsamere Ball [The slower ball]
That's my boy
